limits: Coarse-channel exploratory evaluation, not calibration of the combined legacy/coarse/QR decision.
A single separately reported development smartphone photo is not a held-out validation corpus.
The added carrier changes page RGB values and can be faintly visible. It cannot repair historical copies.
Cropping away the QR band does not necessarily remove this whole-page carrier. Tiny crops, perspective, filtering or scale changes may still defeat it.
OCR reconstruction and reconstruction from the unmarked source can erase every pixel carrier. No recipient attribution is claimed after such erasure.
The earlier 1000-trial v1 false-match bound does not apply to this additional search channel.

physicalPhotoCase.scope: Single private development photograph of a new laboratory copy. No private pixels, EXIF or image hash published. Not a production or independent attribution validation.

browserVerification.scope: Current web production worker executed in desktop Chrome using the same private development photo. Not an Android device or preproduction attribution test.

reportedPreproductionCase.scope: Geometry inspected independently of the marking. Attribution cannot be tested without the derived pattern of this exact copy. No private pixels, EXIF, filenames or source hashes published.
